en.caption: Official PhotoCraft release assets
en.usage.MSI: Windows installer. Match x64, x86 or ARM64 to your system type.
en.usage.Portable ZIP: Windows portable application. Extract the entire ZIP before running it.
en.usage.DMG: macOS desktop installer for Intel and Apple silicon.
en.usage.CLI ZIP: Command-line tools; choose the listed CPU architecture.
en.usage.AppImage: Portable Linux application. Make the file executable before running it.
en.usage.Flatpak: Linux Flatpak bundle; requires Flatpak and the appropriate runtime.
en.usage.DEB: Debian / Ubuntu family package; match the listed CPU architecture.
en.usage.RPM: RPM-based Linux distribution package; match the listed CPU architecture.
en.usage.Arch package: Arch Linux package archive; use the matching architecture and package manager.
en.usage.tar.gz: Binary archive for the listed OS and CPU. Extract it with all supporting files.
en.usage.Web ZIP: Web build files for hosting; this ZIP is not a desktop installer.
en.usage.AppImage update metadata: zsync update data for the corresponding AppImage; not a standalone app.
en.usage.Debug symbols: Windows installer debugging symbols; not an installer or portable app.
en.usage.SHA256 list: Official checksums. This row's SHA256 is computed from the downloaded text file itself.
en.usage.other: Additional official release asset; consult this version's release notes.

zh.caption: PhotoCraft 官方发布文件
zh.usage.MSI: Windows 安装包；按系统类型选择 x64、x86 或 ARM64。
zh.usage.Portable ZIP: Windows 便携版；完整解压后运行，保留随附文件。
zh.usage.DMG: 适用于 Intel 与 Apple 芯片的 macOS 桌面安装包。
zh.usage.CLI ZIP: 命令行工具；按所列 CPU 架构选择。
zh.usage.AppImage: Linux 便携应用；先赋予文件执行权限。
zh.usage.Flatpak: Linux Flatpak 包；需要 Flatpak 及相应运行时。
zh.usage.DEB: Debian / Ubuntu 系发行版安装包；按 CPU 架构选择。
zh.usage.RPM: 使用 RPM 的 Linux 发行版安装包；按 CPU 架构选择。
zh.usage.Arch package: Arch Linux 软件包；使用对应架构与包管理器。
zh.usage.tar.gz: 适用于所列操作系统与 CPU 的二进制归档；完整解压并保留支持文件。
zh.usage.Web ZIP: 用于托管的 Web 构建文件；不是桌面安装包。
zh.usage.AppImage update metadata: 对应 AppImage 的 zsync 更新数据，不能单独运行。
zh.usage.Debug symbols: Windows 安装器调试符号；不是安装包或便携应用。
zh.usage.SHA256 list: 官方校验和列表；本行 SHA256 由下载到的文本文件本身计算。
zh.usage.other: 其他官方发布资产；请查看此版本发布说明。
